instance_note: candidate_key = sha256 of the canonical candidate; identifies the problem instance

configuration.name: S56 memory probe v1 (five_block): corrected SP, staged mixed-duration plan, V-1 per-scenario coupling, alpha 0, cohort all node-years, TV, slack 1e4, flex x2, cap 2

objective_convention: gross_operational_cost: per-scenario TN-DN coupling wired -- the COMPLETE internal TN-DN settlement excluded (author decision 6, 2026-11-21; the Addendum 38 (C) deviation-as-economic-cost treatment withdrawn in this mode); net_operational_recourse = gross minus terminal salvage credit; today's form (contracted part excluded) in terminal_gross_operational_cost_contracted_excluded

bar.definition: max over the last 10 cycles of |gross_operational_cost[k] - gross_operational_cost[k-1]| (settlement-excluded gross cost; the predecessor of the first window row is taken from the full trajectory; a step is unavailable when cycle k-1 is absent or either gross value is None)

bar_net_recourse_step_reported.definition: max objective_change_abs over the last 10 cycles (production: |net_operational_recourse[k] - net_operational_recourse[k-1]|, shared_resources_planning.py:2849/2814; NET of the terminal salvage credit; reported, not the bar)

recourse_components.q_convention_settlement_excluded_in_full: PRIMARY in this mode (author decision 6, 2026-11-21): gross_operational_cost = gross incl. settlement - interface settlement total (TSO + every DSO) - voltage pin; net_operational_recourse = that - terminal salvage; today's form (contracted part and pin excluded) is gross_operational_cost_contracted_excluded / net_operational_recourse_contracted_excluded

settlement_remainder.definition: recourse_components.interface_settlement_total: T_TSO + sum(T_DSO), the non-cancelling interface settlement at the terminal point, excluded from the cost

solve_profile.identity: observed == base + sum over network-failure events of [recovery_attempted] + [tier2_attempted]; unsupported when an ESSO recovery event or an 'indeterminate' network event exists
solve_profile.derivation: (1 + n_dso) * n_years * n_days + n_esso_nodes, per cycle, from the planning object
solve_profile.rounds_note: one initialization round + cycles_run ADMM cycles

recovered_only_identity.note: pre-W35 rule, REPORTED not gated: credits retries only to RECOVERED blocks, so an unrecovered block's attempts go uncounted (78a9b230)

peak_rss.units: bytes on macOS/BSD, kilobytes on Linux (ru_maxrss)
peak_rss.semantics: child_python_process = RUSAGE_SELF of the evaluation process at record time (the evaluation's own peak); production_state = the same measure taken by production at the end of run_operational_planning; solver_subprocesses = RUSAGE_CHILDREN max over the IPOPT executables this evaluation launched; when a post-certification step ran, child_python_process includes it (the ADMM run alone is production_state)

ess_ageing_readback_terminal.method: numerical read-back from the built rows (model_variant_readback) against the declaration's closed forms; on clones of the given models

flex_price_applied_in_child.where_applied: pre_solve_hook (after _construct_arm_planning, before run_operational_planning): DSO network[year][day].cost_flex replaced by m * cost_flex (new arrays); DSO holder cost_flex rebound; TSO and planning.cost_flex untouched; no file edited

readback_pre_run.method: probe DSO blocks built by production network.build_model(params) before and after the replacement; objective standard repn compared (compare_flex_price_summaries)

sigma_calibration.definition: sigma_computed = max over TSO/DSO blocks of |w_b * f_b| at the initialization solve (shared_resources_planning._compute_common_admm_objective_scale); the resolver raises unless 1/F <= sigma_computed/sigma_fixed <= F

multiscenario_terminal.objective_convention: per-scenario obj = production base SMOPF objective per scenario (no settlement, no row 18, no voltage pin); per-scenario TN-DN coupling wired: Q per block = sum_s omega_s obj_s + (settlement - settlement) + row 18 charge, i.e. the COMPLETE settlement excluded = the primary gross_operational_cost convention in this mode (_get_operational_recourse_block_components / weight); today's form (contracted part excluded) is recourse_components.gross_operational_cost_contracted_excluded
multiscenario_terminal.dispersion_convention: d_{s,t} = p_int_{s,t} - pbar_t (the DSO block's own committed schedule); block-local, probability-weighted; *_sum_over_blocks = summed over the DSO's (year, day) blocks UNWEIGHTED (MWh per representative day summed, the W44 convention); *_weighted = weighted by _get_admm_block_weight (the Q weighting)

settlement_identity.definition: Addendum 38 (C): residual := T_TSO + sum_DSO T_DSO (interface_settlement_total) == the price-deviation covariance (interface_settlement_deviation_total) + the leftover priced interface consensus residual (interface_settlement_identity_residual = the contracted parts, which cancel at consensus); the covariance is also recomputed here from the models

operational_workbook.point: terminal models of the run, BEFORE any post-certification step

activation_readback.point: after _prepare_distribution_objectives_for_admm and _prepare_transmission_objectives_for_admm; before any ADMM-cycle solve
